text: {"assertions":["A truncated documents bug was found in search/indexer/chunker.ts on 2026-06-18.","The bug manifested as chunk offsets that stopped short of the document length on the staging read replica.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation in the chunker.","The fix was implemented in PR #4367 on branch fix/truncated-documents-1 by prefetching the relation in a single query.","The bug could be reproduced by indexing the long changelog fixture.","After the fix, the error rate improved from 5.3% down to under 0.06% (6 per ten thousand)."]}
